changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdiagnosticordertests AS SELECT dot.id, dot.status, dot.order_id, dot.test_id, dot.received_department_id, dot.reason, dot.notes, dot.processing_status, dot.submit_date, dot.accepted_date, dot.rejected_date, dot.cancelled_date, dot.patient_arrived_date, dot.ready_date, dot.approved_date, dot.order_type, dot.accepted_by, dot.rejected_by, dot.cancelled_by, dot.rejected_reason, dot.patient_arrived_note_rad, dot.cancellation_reason, dot.undo_accept_reason, dot.undo_accept_by, dot.undo_accept_date, dot.icd_diagnosis_id, dot.created_date, dot.created_by, dot.last_modified_by, dot.last_modified_date FROM public.diagnostic_order_tests dot;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnosticordertests TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnosticordertests FROM report_user;
